title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - LinearElementSection
description: Linear Element Section (era:LinearElementSection's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents a section of a linear element. Inherits attributes from era:LinearElement/era:NetElement/era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LinearElementSection'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

appliesInBothDirections.description: Property. Specifies if the section applies in both directions (optional).

endOffsetFromOrigin.description: Property. End offset of the section from the origin.

onElement.description: Relationship. Specifies the linear element a section belongs to.

startOffsetFromOrigin.description: Property. Start offset of the section from the origin.

lengthOfNetLinearElement.description: Property. Length of a topological linear element.

lengthOfNonStoppingArea.description: Property. Length of a Non-stopping area. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.14.5)

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
